title: IBM二季度遭抛售：三季度营收171亿超预期，AI顺风能否延续？

segments.en: You know why I remember coming off of that Q2 report that shocked a lot of people with regards to the slowdown and software growth It does look they rebounded a bit here in the third quarter overall revenue for the third quarter 17.1 billion that's a beat

segments.en: Though it all kind of smoothed out and it's still relatively flat on the year But he sees an acceleration going forward A company also saying very clearly here that they see a lot of tailwinds when it comes to the AI space and their strategy of maybe

segments.en: I remember all of the agita that we saw three months ago when this stock sold off everybody thought something's wrong here What did you make of this report that we got today? Is this sort of absolution?
